name: Peruaçu River Canyon
description: Peruaçu River Canyon, in northern Minas Gerais, Brazil, is a limestone landscape where a river cuts through huge, nearly horizontal caves. Visitors can see sunken dolines, natural stone arches, underground streams and formations hanging from cave ceilings. The park also sits where three biomes meet, the Cerrado, Caatinga and Atlantic Forest, and shelters more than 2,000 plant and animal species.
